title: Lead Me to Calvary
lyrics: [C]King of my life, I [F]crown Thee [C]now, Thine shall the glory [G]be;
[C]Lest I forget Thy [F]thorn crowned [C]brow, Lead me to Cal-[G7]va- [C]ry.
[G]Lest I for-[G7]get Geth-[C]semane, [G]Lest I for-[G7]get Thine [C]agony;
[Am]Lest I for-[E7]get Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to Cal-[G7]va- [C]ry.
[G]Lest I for-[G7]get Geth-[C]semane, [G]Lest I for-[G7]get Thine [C]agony;
[Am]Lest I for-[E7]get Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to Cal-[G7]va- [C]ry.
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Let me like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb,
May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Even Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.
